rating_scope: Candidate engineering maturity, separately qualified by availability and missing customer/operational evidence. Candidate has not been deployed.

priority_scale.P1: Affected-offering purchase, trust, safety or operational release blocker

evidence_conventions: Repository-relative file:line references refer to the source candidate, except revision-specific artifacts and operational documents. CI merge additionally includes six reviewed upstream UI/document files; passing tests do not prove paid readiness. No customer-call content, secrets or environment values are included.
acceptance_conventions: Every next_acceptance entry proposes a future acceptance condition; none is represented as a measured result or new blanket approval requirement.

commercial_launch_decision.supported_next_step: Operator-assisted, explicitly scoped pilot only after the relevant confirmed defects, deployment prerequisites and designated-account acceptance gates are addressed.
commercial_launch_decision.important_qualification: Known defects do not erase the substantial level-2 engineering of calling, providers, lead evidence, recording deletion and durable connectors. No feature is rated 3 or 4 without sufficient pilot or sustained production proof.

availability_constraints.constraint: Candidate changes are not installed in production.
Inbound human transfer is intentionally unavailable in production despite level-2 implementation.
New frontend readiness controls require matching backend endpoint/field support; promote and roll back coordinated versions.
Effective paid Stripe mode, plan prices, provider accounts, owned numbers and connector destinations require verification; their live configuration was not inspected in this matrix audit.
SIP OPTIONS freshness is not a connected-call or heard-audio guarantee; hand-managed AoRs and existing generated configurations need the documented release work.
Caller-ID ownership remains required; removing a stored static STIR token check does not establish per-call carrier attestation or determine region-specific obligations.

audit_methods: Existing candidate/merge CI and sanitized evidence review
No-I/O reproduction of the actual subscription webhook retry method
No new customer calls, payments, messages, connector effects or production changes
No-provider reproduction of the actual Realtime contact-history bound and relationship guard

features.feature: Performance, scale and customer-outcome claims
features.client_risk: Homepage response-time, concurrency and completion figures have no reviewed measurement provenance; they must not be treated as purchased guarantees.
features.next_acceptance: Provide dated definitions, sample, deployment configuration and approved evidence for each numeric claim, or remove the claim.

features.feature: Contact and sales enquiry submission
features.client_risk: The public form clears input and reports success after a timer without sending or saving the enquiry.
features.next_acceptance: A designated intake system receives one enquiry; failure preserves the draft and never reports sent; retry does not duplicate.

features.feature: Verified signup and duplicate-email handling
features.client_risk: The main code-verification flow is implemented, but the still-mounted legacy register endpoint inserts an unsupported owner role.
features.next_acceptance: Exercise every published signup path against migrated schema: verified inbox before session, canonical role and tenant membership, duplicate race rollback.

features.feature: Login, password recovery, MFA, passkeys and sessions
features.client_risk: Security/session code and tests exist; real mailbox recovery and complete cross-device failure journeys were not established in this audit.
features.next_acceptance: Demonstrate designated-account reset, MFA/passkey recovery, refresh, logout and revocation without stale access or misleading success.

features.feature: Tenant roles, membership and staff onboarding
features.client_risk: Backend role ceilings and tenant membership are implemented; a complete email invitation and acceptance journey remains unverified.
features.next_acceptance: An owner invites staff, staff accepts into the correct tenant, limited roles cannot escalate, and removal revokes access across sessions.

features.feature: New-tenant setup and first authorized call
features.client_risk: Setup spans several screens; a seeded plan/trunk is not proof of active entitlement, verified caller ID, healthy route or configured knowledge.
features.next_acceptance: A new nontechnical buyer completes documented setup and one owned-number test call without undocumented database edits; each missing prerequisite has a useful reason.

features.feature: Monthly subscription checkout and activation
features.client_risk: Real Stripe integration exists, but effective live configuration and the paid buyer lifecycle were not verified; event recovery defects are tracked separately.
features.next_acceptance: Complete an authorized designated-account purchase with matching amount/currency, signed webhook, entitlement, receipt and renewal state; prove the server is not in mock mode.

features.feature: Annual plan selection
features.client_risk: The yearly discount changes displayed price only; checkout still sends the same plan ID and uses its single Stripe price.
features.next_acceptance: Monthly and yearly choices select distinct server-validated recurring prices whose amount, currency and interval match all customer screens.

features.feature: Minute top-ups and refund accounting
features.client_risk: Top-up/refund ledger fences exist, but real charge/refund reconciliation and a customer refund-request journey are not demonstrated.
features.recommended_owner: Billing engineering and finance operations lead
features.next_acceptance: One designated purchase credits once; duplicate and partial/full refund events reconcile once to provider and ledger; the customer can obtain the documented support outcome.

features.feature: Subscription and invoice webhook recovery
features.client_risk: A failed ordinary business handler leaves its event claimed; redelivery is ignored as duplicate. Dedup-storage failure also permits unclaimed processing, without proving duplicate charges.
features.next_acceptance: Inject failure at each handler boundary; retries complete exactly once and only completed processing is acknowledged as duplicate, preserving downstream credit/upsert fences.

features.feature: Invoice detail, adjustments and price transparency
features.client_risk: Invoice detail substitutes plan minutes for actual use and zero for unrecorded tax/overage/credits; missing overage rate becomes an assumed price.
features.recommended_owner: Billing engineering and finance operations lead
features.next_acceptance: Provider invoice lines, tax, discounts, usage and credits match displayed historical detail; missing facts show unavailable and later plan edits do not rewrite history.

features.feature: Customer cancellation and billing portal
features.client_risk: Period-end cancellation and portal APIs exist, but no frontend consumer was located despite terms promising account-settings cancellation; manual email remains a stated alternative.
features.next_acceptance: An authorized owner can request cancellation, see the confirmed end date after reload, retain purchased access and avoid renewal; ambiguous provider outcomes never claim success.

features.feature: AI Options, saved settings and campaign selection
features.client_risk: Provider/model controls and persistence are implemented; matching frontend/backend and effective per-campaign configuration still need released acceptance.
features.next_acceptance: Save each supported configuration, reload, assign it to a campaign and verify the effective runtime model/voice/prompt without silently changing defaults.

features.feature: Traditional model adapters and tool continuation
features.client_risk: Four traditional providers have real adapters and synthetic proof, but supported tools/settings do not guarantee equivalent semantic quality or account limits.
features.next_acceptance: For each offered model, verify streaming, nullable tool inputs, continuation, provider error/EOF behavior and no side-effect replay using the actual supported configuration. Record effective temperature, reasoning and output budgets for the chosen model; do not infer semantic correctness from low temperature.

features.feature: Native Realtime configuration and lifecycle
features.client_risk: Realtime has separate settings and actual OpenAI provider smoke evidence with simulated playback; xAI live acceptance remains unverified. The customer-relationship guard loses an explicit correction when its 12-message buffer rolls over. This proves lost guard coverage, not inevitable model failure.
features.next_acceptance: Preserve explicit relationship corrections beyond the contact buffer until a genuine caller reversal; prove both cases, then validate persona, knowledge/actions, interruption and closure on an owned call without effect replay. Verify the provider-specific effective VAD, noise, speed and token settings; legacy temperature must not leak into the native payload.

features.feature: Campaign document ingestion and grounded retrieval
features.client_risk: Scoped retrieval and source/price guards are implemented, but traditional no/weak-answer instructions promise to check or confirm even when no follow-up route exists. Output occurrence is unproven here; document coverage and qualitative accuracy remain unmeasured.
features.next_acceptance: Remove unsupported follow-up promises while retaining available-action confirmation; test no/weak evidence with and without a real route, then measure source, caveat and price accuracy against representative approved documents.

features.feature: STT adapters and bounded recognition recovery
features.client_risk: Actual PCM fixtures and failure tests support adapter operation, not accent/noise/telephone recognition accuracy; fallback may share the same vendor/account.
features.next_acceptance: Use representative owned telephone audio to measure content and exact-contact recognition separately; prove EOF, silence, overflow and recovery do not falsely confirm data.

features.feature: TTS adapters, fallback and transport receipts
features.client_risk: Provider audio, bounded startup and partial-output safety are implemented; actual selected voice quality/fallback over PSTN is not established, and transmission is not hearing.
features.next_acceptance: Test selected primary/mapped fallback voices before and after partial audio; no duplicated speech, fabricated completion or leaked media resources.

features.feature: Turn-taking, interruption, contact readback and closure
features.client_risk: Caller-scoped closure and confidence/readback boundaries have regression tests; echo, jitter, speakerphone and real caller interruption behavior remain unmeasured for this release.
features.next_acceptance: Real calls cover correction, topic refusal, quoted goodbye, explicit opt-out and interruption; no premature hangup or falsely confirmed email/phone, with complete resource cleanup.

features.feature: End-to-end audio quality and semantic comprehension
features.client_risk: Synthetic Groq output misremembers the prior question despite correct wire history; no release-bound caller-heard latency, accent/noise corpus or representative business-success rate is established.
features.next_acceptance: Agree a representative owned-call corpus and targets, then measure caller-heard latency, comprehension, unsupported claims, correction burden and exact-contact accuracy with all failures reported.

features.feature: Outbound campaigns, scheduling and launch controls
features.client_risk: Durable queue and shared route preflight exist; current-candidate carrier launch/pause/stop under real concurrency is not pilot-validated.
features.next_acceptance: Start, pause, stop and resume an owned campaign under normal and failed carrier/queue conditions; preserve jobs, suppression and truthful pending status.

features.feature: Inbound DID/extension routing and admission
features.client_risk: Tenant/direction routing and durable admission are engineered; actual current-release carrier routing, consent and settlement need acceptance.
features.next_acceptance: Each assigned owned DID/extension reaches only its intended tenant/campaign; unassigned or unauthorized ingress is rejected and holds/usage settle once.

features.feature: Controlled inbound human transfer
features.client_risk: Implementation and tests exist, but production transfer is deliberately disabled; buyers requiring receptionist-to-human handoff cannot rely on it.
features.next_acceptance: Complete the existing allowlisted two-leg carrier, teardown, restart and settlement gates before enabling production; otherwise exclude transfer from the purchased scope.

features.feature: SIP credentials, IP authentication, health and deletion
features.client_risk: Readiness is independent of enabled state and preserves real response codes; the candidate 10-second timer is not deployed and OPTIONS health is not successful PSTN audio.
features.next_acceptance: Deploy generated configuration and timer, verify hand-managed AoRs, test register/IP-auth directions and unused-trunk deletion; stale/down evidence blocks outbound launch.

features.feature: Caller ID, route ownership and carrier attestation
features.client_risk: Current selected route and tenant ownership replace unrelated defaults; static STIR token removal is not proof of carrier attestation or authority to use any number.
features.next_acceptance: Verify owned caller-ID presentation on actual destinations and carrier signing responsibilities, including Canada; correct legacy allocations without cross-tenant fallback.

features.feature: DNC, caller opt-out and recording consent
features.client_risk: Suppression and consent mechanisms exist; jurisdictional policy correctness and actual carrier/recording enforcement are not a blanket compliance certification.
features.next_acceptance: Actual opt-out persists and prevents future admission; topic refusal does not become DNC; recording behavior follows configured disclosure/consent before retaining audio.

features.feature: Explicit Dial again and uncertain queue recovery
features.client_risk: Stable job identity and real PostgreSQL concurrency tests exist, but a queue receipt is not a connected call and fresh live redial acceptance has not occurred.
features.next_acceptance: One authorized explicit reattempt produces one job/call, preserving destination and guards; lost queue acknowledgement retries the same request, never a new identity.

features.feature: Contact import, manual editing and normalization
features.client_risk: Real import and editing are implemented; representative dirty CSVs, duplicates, country formats and customer recovery effort need buyer acceptance.
features.next_acceptance: Import a representative mapped CSV, review rejected/duplicate rows, correct a contact and verify unchanged tenant/campaign ownership and intended E.164 destination.

features.feature: Lead evidence, corrections and Sales Hub projection
features.client_risk: Revision-safe contact evidence and CRM states are implemented. Additional business details are reviewable caller quotes marked needs_review, not verified scalar facts; automatic qualification and correction workload remain unmeasured.
features.next_acceptance: A real authorized call produces sourced fields, separates confirmed/unconfirmed values, preserves later manual corrections and shows each destination receipt independently.

features.feature: Assistant tools, reviewed actions and durable execution
features.client_risk: Permissions, frozen reviewed arguments and unknown-outcome fences are engineered; tool availability is not proof every desired business workflow is supported.
features.next_acceptance: For each sold action, demonstrate authorized preview/confirmation, exact recipient/payload, durable receipt and safe unknown/retry/restart behavior without model-created approval.

features.feature: Email and calendar delivery
features.client_risk: Services require provider receipts and pinned credentials; OAuth connected status or mocked browser flow does not establish inbox delivery or a real calendar event.
features.next_acceptance: Designated accounts receive one correct email/event; refresh, revocation, timeout and cancellation yield honest accepted/failed/unknown status without duplicate effects.

features.feature: Independent CRM destinations and retries
features.client_risk: Durable provider-specific/account-pinned receipts exist; real customer CRM schema, reconnect and permissions behavior remains unvalidated for deployment.
features.next_acceptance: Each approved CRM receives the correct contact/activity once; one failure does not erase another success; account switch during retry holds for review.

features.feature: Customer alerts, webhook routing and billing emails
features.client_risk: Webhook delivery is browser-only with ignored errors and unscoped local storage; payment-email lookup uses legacy owner role. Local toasts and server event records do exist.
features.next_acceptance: Tenant switches cannot expose prior lead alerts or inherit destinations; closed-browser delivery follows an explicit durable policy, and canonical billing recipients receive observable receipts.

features.feature: Recordings, export, deletion and retention
features.client_risk: Permissioned recording download/deletion exist; whole-tenant export, policy-wide retention enforcement and verifiable deletion across every store are not established.
features.recommended_owner: Data lifecycle and privacy operations lead
features.next_acceptance: Complete one authorized export/deletion request and scheduled retention run across recordings, transcripts, metadata and backups, retaining auditable exceptions and customer receipt.

features.feature: Dashboards, analytics and call history
features.client_risk: Real API-backed metrics, error states and actual-leg caller ID are implemented; business ROI, attribution definitions and customer decision usefulness are not proven by rendering tests.
features.next_acceptance: Reconcile representative calls, outcomes, minutes and filters to authoritative records, distinguish outage from zero and document conversion/qualification denominators.

features.feature: Admin support and incident consoles
features.client_risk: Several operational APIs work, but Actions Log/Incidents and selected customer-admin consoles are placeholders or unavailable; not all support tasks can be completed through the UI.
features.next_acceptance: A restricted support operator can trace and reconcile a complaint across call, action, provider, lead and billing evidence using audited supported controls.

features.feature: White-label tenant provisioning, suspension and billing
features.client_risk: Evaluated pages use localStorage-only tenant mutations and hardcoded bills without visible demo disclosure; real backend tenant APIs do not make those screens operational.
features.next_acceptance: A created tenant persists across browsers with actual membership/entitlement; suspension blocks backend work; bills reflect real records or the pages are clearly unavailable/demo.

features.feature: Mobile, keyboard access and accessible states
features.client_risk: Responsive components and selected accessibility checks exist, but no complete paid/setup/cancellation journey or accessibility conformance is demonstrated; an unnamed billing switch remains.
features.next_acceptance: Complete critical journeys by keyboard, screen reader and small-screen touch, including failed requests; verify names, focus, dialogs, overflow and recovery using the released UI.

features.feature: Minutes, spend limits and admission during outages
features.client_risk: Quota and spend mechanisms exist, but selective metering failure can allow new outbound work; calendar-month usage and subscription anniversary policy need explicit alignment.
features.next_acceptance: Fail only the usage query while other guards work and verify the agreed bounded admission policy; reconcile every displayed balance and reset date without calling unknown unlimited.

features.feature: Provider-account limits and global concurrency
features.client_risk: Existing provider guards are per-process and do not cover selected Flux sockets; outbound global admission can degrade open on Redis failure. Other tenant/call limits still apply.
features.next_acceptance: With actual account/process topology, prove the configured provider and global limits, cancellation release and declared Redis-outage behavior without duplicate origination.

features.feature: Metrics, health, alerting and on-call delivery
features.client_risk: Metrics, worker heartbeats and healthwatch exist; empty baseline pager receivers and no reviewed paging drill prevent an operational response guarantee.
features.next_acceptance: Inject worker/provider/queue faults and record notification, acknowledgement and recovery at the designated on-call destination within agreed targets.

features.feature: Sustained capacity and service-level evidence
features.client_risk: Historical small SIP-only soak evidence was invalidated; idle host health and synthetic provider turns do not establish current capacity, high availability or caller-heard latency.
features.next_acceptance: At contracted concurrency, run an agreed representative bidirectional call soak plus overload/fault cases; report latency distributions, setup success, costs and leaked resources.

features.feature: Backups, restore and disaster recovery
features.client_risk: Scheduled dump success and restore procedures exist; restored production-shaped data, off-host survivability and measured RTO/RPO are not established.
features.next_acceptance: Restore an authorized off-host copy into isolation, validate tenant/RLS/application/object-store evidence and measure recovery against agreed RTO/RPO.

features.feature: Drain, deployment compatibility and rollback
features.client_risk: Candidate is undeployed; gateway/Python/schema compatibility, generated SIP reconciliation and a topology-specific freeze/rollback rehearsal remain operator prerequisites.
features.next_acceptance: Promote the reviewed tested merge through a genuine candidate-bound drain; verify matching builds, migrations and UI, then rehearse approved rollback/code-forward without erasing receipts.

features.feature: Security controls, privacy documentation and regulated-use claims
features.client_risk: Substantial auth/RLS/credential/security gates exist; provider/subprocessor documentation is stale and certification, DPA, regulated-use readiness and support-process evidence are not established by code.
features.next_acceptance: Align published suppliers, retention and transfer facts with deployed processing; verify contracts and evidence for claims, and exercise permission, incident and data-request procedures.
